pumi.events.v1.PlanAdded.jsonschema.json.description:
PlanAdded is the data of dev.getpumi.plan.added: a plan joins a track,
 including a plan split from another.

^(depends_on)$.description:
The plans this one depends on: plans added earlier in the same track.
 The plan starts only when each of them has merged (decisions 0196 and
 0197).

^(split_from)$.description: The plan this one was split from, or empty.
